scope: snapshot unboosted exact Born-Oppenheimer electronic eigenstates; verification of delivered R10O operator definitions, not new dynamics

origin.definition: instantaneous center of nuclear charge O=(Z1 R1+Z2 R2)/(Z1+Z2)
origin.meaning: O-centered clamped-nuclei snapshot; origin translation in time is not part of audited angular term
origin.source_status: declared audit convention; CPC Sec2.6 does not explicitly fix this translational/ETF origin

phase.real_basis: away from degeneracy choose real sigma and real pi meridional factors with smooth local R continuation; overall sign remains gauge
phase.allowed_gauge: chi_a(R) independent of theta in the specified rotation section; radial connection transforms including diagonal derivative

state_names.g: lowest sigma branch with UA1s and outgoing He+1s correlation as supplied source context
state_names.at_degeneracy: use projector/subspace; no arbitrary scalar continuation or gap division

cylindrical_phi: x=rho*cos(phi),y=rho*sin(phi); rho is electronic transverse radius, not collision impact parameter
normalizations: sigma=G(rho,z)/sqrt(2pi); pi_x=A(rho,z)cos(phi)/sqrt(pi); pi_y=A(rho,z)sin(phi)/sqrt(pi); integral rho drho dz |G|²=integral rho drho dz |A|²=1

ETF_translation.in_this_overlap: unboosted stationary orbitals; no electron translation factor
ETF_translation.time_dependent_translation: a moving O frame requires its own -Odot·p connection and corresponding Galilean/ETF accounting
ETF_translation.authority_limit: no physical missing-edge amplitude inferred solely by choosing a convenient origin or dropping translational contributions

CPC_sign_binding.comparison: axes alone do not flip sign; mapping omega=-theta_dot would reconcile coefficients only if opposite angular/passive convention is adopted explicitly

UA_limit_conditions: At R=0 spherical H preserves l. A limiting-zero overlap claim additionally requires state convergence controlling the L_y domain; plain L2 continuity is insufficient. Such convergence is not proved here.
